paper_title: Frequency Ratio Measurements with 18-digit Accuracy Using a Network of Optical Clocks
notes: The arXiv version of this paper (2005.14694, only v1 exists, submitted 2020-05-29) reports optical clock frequency ratio measurements (Al+/Yb, Al+/Sr, Yb/Sr) with 6-8e-18 uncertainty by the BACON collaboration. Neither the provided 51-page PDF (main text + supplementary) nor the arXiv e-print LaTeX source/figures contains any ultralight dark matter search or exclusion limit: dark matter is mentioned only once, as a prospective future application ('searching for undiscovered particles... such as the nature of dark matter'). No coupling-vs-mass constraint (e.g. on the dilatonic coupling d_e) is derived in this version. A dark-matter constraint may appear in the later journal-published version, but it is not present in the arXiv material permitted for this task, so no data points are reported.
